rationale: The continuation thesis is fully intact — at $8.51 the stock still holds above the rising session VWAP ($8.31) and 9-EMA ($8.35), sits in the top quartile of the day range on 10x RVOL, and the single post-entry candle is a small, sub-average-volume (59K vs ~120K/min pace) consolidation rather than distribution, with zero adverse excursion since entry. Keeping the original $8.28 invalidation just below VWAP preserves the defined ~$180 initial risk while giving room for follow-through toward the $8.65 high; there is no mechanical evidence of failure to justify closing, and no reversal signal (no rejection candle, no headline, no VWAP break) to support flipping short against gap strength.
